snippet.title: Pro Jank Footy | Console Trailer
snippet.description:
FOOOOOTY!
 
Watch the new trailer for PRO JANK FOOTY with commentary from Broden Kelly!

Australia will finally get the footy game it deserves, with Pro Jank Footy releasing across all major consoles including PlayStation (PS5), Xbox (Series X|S), Nintendo (Switch, Switch 2), as well as PC and Steam Deck in 2026.
 
Play the demo for free this Feb 23 on Steam.
